top_stories.label: Top Stories
top_stories.ai_summary: Russia unleashed one of its heaviest missile-and-drone barrages on Kyiv in months, killing at least 17 people in an 11-hour overnight assault; Ukraine hit back at a major Russian oil refinery. In the Middle East, Iran finally set slain supreme leader Ali Khamenei's funeral for 4-9 July as US-Iran indirect talks in Doha edged forward. Elsewhere a European heatwave fanned wildfires in France, the US declined to renew the North American trade deal, and World Cup celebrations turned deadly in Mexico.

stories.headline: 'Most massive' Russian attack on Kyiv kills at least 17
stories.summary: Russia launched one of its largest missile-and-drone barrages on Kyiv in months overnight into 2 July, killing at least 17 people and injuring dozens across an 11-hour assault, Ukrainian officials said; the toll was still rising. Kyiv said it retaliated by striking a major Russian oil refinery at Kstovo.

stories.headline: Iran sets Khamenei funeral for 4-9 July as US-Iran talks progress in Doha
stories.summary: Iran will hold funeral rites for late supreme leader Ali Khamenei -- killed in a 28 Feb US-Israeli strike -- from 4 July in Tehran, with burial in Mashhad on 9 July. Qatar-mediated indirect US-Iran talks in Doha reported 'positive progress', with the next round expected after the funeral.

stories.headline: US blocks long-term renewal of North American trade deal
stories.summary: Washington declined to extend the long-term renewal of the North American free-trade pact, unsettling Canada and Mexico and reviving trade-war concerns. The move keeps tariffs and market access in flux for the region's automakers and exporters.

stories.headline: Firefighters battle blazes in southern France after European heatwave
stories.summary: A punishing European heatwave has fanned wildfires across southern France, with firefighters battling blazes as temperatures spike. Authorities warned of more heat to come, and France reported a scramble for air-conditioning ahead of the next hot spell.

stories.headline: Nine Thai monks killed after 11-year-old drives truck into procession
stories.summary: Nine Buddhist monks were killed in Thailand when an 11-year-old boy driving a truck ploughed into a religious procession, authorities said. The crash has renewed scrutiny of road safety and underage driving.

stories.headline: Four dead as huge crowds celebrate Mexico's World Cup win
stories.summary: At least four people died as huge crowds poured into the streets of Mexico City to celebrate the national team's World Cup victory. Officials urged calm amid the crush of revellers.

stories.headline: China says pilot crashed small plane into Beijing skyscraper for 'personal reasons'
stories.summary: Chinese authorities said a pilot deliberately flew a small plane into a Beijing skyscraper for 'personal reasons'. CNA reported the pilot had written about ending his life; investigators are examining the circumstances.

stories.headline: German prosecutors charge Ukrainian suspect over Nord Stream blasts
stories.summary: German prosecutors filed charges against a Ukrainian man over the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline explosions, a case that has strained ties in Europe. His alleged role is central to the long-running investigation.

stories.headline: Asian shares fall as chipmakers drag; US jobs data looms
stories.summary: Asian equities slipped as chipmakers weighed on indexes and investors braced for key US jobs data. The pullback followed volatility in AI-related stocks from Wall Street to Seoul.

singapore.label: Singapore
singapore.ai_summary: It's a wet one -- NEA forecasts thundery showers with highs around 33C. Authorities are tightening safety and transport rules: timber scaffolds must now come down within three months to cut fire risk, and the North East and Sengkang-Punggol LRT power systems will be upgraded from 2027. Police have 230 people, including a 16-year-old, under probe over $9m in scams. On the lighter side, Night Safari bid farewell to white tiger Pasha.

stories.headline: Singapore to shorten timber scaffold use from 9 months to 3 to improve fire safety
stories.summary: Manpower Minister Tan See Leng said timber scaffolds must be dismantled within three months, down from nine, to cut fire risk -- a change informed by the 2025 Hong Kong scaffold blaze. The rule tightens construction fire-safety requirements.

stories.headline: NEL and Sengkang-Punggol LRT power systems to be upgraded from 2027
stories.summary: The power systems for the North East Line and Sengkang-Punggol LRT will be progressively upgraded from 2027, with works completed by the mid-2030s, to improve reliability. Operators said disruption during the phased upgrade should be minimal.

stories.headline: 16-year-old among 230 under probe over scams involving $9 million in losses
stories.summary: Police are investigating 230 people, including a 16-year-old, for suspected roles in scams that caused about $9 million in losses. The suspects allegedly acted as money mules or helped facilitate fraudulent transfers.

stories.headline: MSF to spend $15m on new tech, including AI to analyse at-risk families
stories.summary: The Ministry of Social and Family Development will invest $15 million in new technology, including AI tools to flag at-risk families and help write case notes, aiming to speed up social workers' response. Officials said human judgment stays central to decisions.

stories.headline: Residents in towns like Sembawang, Bukit Panjang, Punggol have longest work commutes
stories.summary: A study found residents of Sembawang, Bukit Panjang and Punggol face the longest journeys to work, reflecting the gap between where homes and jobs are concentrated. Planners pointed to decentralisation and new rail links as part of the fix.

stories.headline: NTU provost Christian Wolfrum to lead Singapore's national AI programme
stories.summary: NTU provost Christian Wolfrum has been named executive chairman of AI Singapore, the national AI programme, as the country deepens its push into artificial intelligence. The appointment signals continued investment in local AI capability.

stories.headline: Two arrested, four hospitalised after alleged brawl in Orchard Road
stories.summary: Two men were arrested and four people taken to hospital after a fight broke out near an Orchard Road nightclub, police said. One man was allegedly stabbed; investigations are ongoing.

stories.headline: RIP Pasha: Night Safari's white Bengal tiger euthanised after cancer battle
stories.summary: Night Safari's 13-year-old white Bengal tiger, Pasha, was euthanised after a battle with cancer, the wildlife park said. Keepers described him as a long-time favourite among visitors.

stories.headline: Baby civets found by dog-walker near drain at Petir Road, mistaken for kittens
stories.summary: A dog-walker in Bukit Panjang found a litter of baby civets near a drain at Petir Road, at first mistaking them for kittens -- a reminder of the native wildlife that lives among HDB estates. The find drew attention online.

wars.label: Wars & Conflicts
wars.ai_summary: Russia's war on Ukraine escalated with a deadly overnight strike on Kyiv that killed at least 17, answered by Ukrainian hits on Russian oil and rail targets. The US-Israel-Iran front holds an uneasy truce in place since April: oil is again flowing through the Strait of Hormuz and Iran has scheduled Khamenei's funeral for early July as indirect talks continue in Doha. In Gaza, an October ceasefire holds only loosely, with near-daily Israeli strikes still killing Palestinians.

theatres.name: Russia-Ukraine War
theatres.status: Escalating -- Russia hit Kyiv with a deadly overnight barrage on 2 July; Ukraine struck Russian oil and rail targets in reply.

timeline.event: Russia launched one of its largest missile-and-drone attacks on Kyiv in months, killing at least 17 and injuring dozens over an 11-hour assault; Ukraine said it struck a major Russian oil refinery at Kstovo in response.
A Ukrainian drone injured two people aboard a Belarusian tourist bus travelling through Russia, Russian officials said (claim not independently verified).
German prosecutors charged a Ukrainian man over the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline blasts.
Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, beginning the largest land war in Europe since 1945.

theatres.name: US/Israel-Iran (Strait of Hormuz)
theatres.status: Uneasy truce holding since April; Qatar-mediated US-Iran talks continue; Iran to bury supreme leader Khamenei in early July.

timeline.event: Saudi supertankers made the kingdom's biggest oil flow through the Strait of Hormuz since the Iran war truce, a sign of normalising shipping.
US and Iranian negotiators reported 'positive progress' in Qatar-mediated indirect talks in Doha; the next round is expected after Khamenei's funeral.
Iran set funeral rites for late supreme leader Ali Khamenei -- killed in a 28 Feb US-Israeli strike -- for 4 July in Tehran, with burial in Mashhad on 9 July.
Iran's supreme leader Ali Khamenei was killed in a joint US-Israeli airstrike on Tehran during the war between Iran and Israel/US.

theatres.name: Israel-Gaza
theatres.status: Fragile October ceasefire holding loosely; near-daily Israeli strikes continue amid a dire humanitarian situation.

timeline.event: Israel marked 1,000 days since the 7 October 2023 attacks with memorials and protests, as hostage families pressed for a full resolution.
Patients in Gaza faced long delays for medical evacuation amid shortages, the BBC reported.
At least three Palestinians were killed in an Israeli drone strike in northern Gaza near al-Hilu station despite the ceasefire, Palestinian sources said.
Israel and Hamas agreed a US-brokered ceasefire, largely pausing full-scale fighting after two years of war; Israeli strikes have continued since.

outbreaks.label: Outbreaks
outbreaks.ai_summary: The Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic in DR Congo and Uganda is the gravest active outbreak, with WHO confirming 915 cases and 234 deaths as of mid-June and numbers still climbing. India is handling a single, fatal-risk Nipah case in Kerala under tight contact tracing, and WHO has flagged rising yellow fever transmission across Africa and the Americas. None poses a direct threat to Singapore, but the Ebola trajectory warrants close watching.

outbreaks.name: Bundibugyo Ebola -- DR Congo & Uganda
outbreaks.status: Rising rapidly; health-care transmission a concern
outbreaks.scope_note: WHO-confirmed only, DRC + Uganda combined (DRC 896 cases; Uganda 19 cases, 2 deaths), per WHO DON608, 19 Jun 2026; 88 patients recovered. Suspected cases run higher.

outbreaks.name: Nipah virus -- Kerala, India
outbreaks.status: Single confirmed case; contact tracing under way
outbreaks.scope_note: One lab-confirmed case in Kozhikode, Kerala (adult male, on ventilator), per WHO DON609, 25 Jun 2026. Nipah is a high case-fatality virus; contacts are under monitoring.

outbreaks.name: Yellow fever -- Africa & Americas
outbreaks.status: Elevated transmission risk across two regions
outbreaks.scope_note: WHO DON610 (24 Jun 2026) flags sustained yellow fever transmission in Africa and rising spread in the Americas; 27 African and 13 Americas countries are high-risk. This is a situational risk assessment, not a single-outbreak case count.

stories.headline: WHO: Bundibugyo Ebola cases in DR Congo and Uganda climb to 915, 234 deaths
stories.summary: WHO reported 915 confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases and 234 deaths across DR Congo (896 cases) and Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths) as of mid-June, up sharply from the prior update. Health-care-associated transmission is amplifying spread; 88 patients have recovered.

stories.headline: WHO confirms fatal-risk Nipah virus case in Kerala, India
stories.summary: WHO confirmed a laboratory-positive Nipah virus case in Kozhikode, Kerala -- an adult male on ventilator support -- with symptom onset on 30 May. Extensive contact tracing is under way given Nipah's high fatality rate and person-to-person spread.

stories.headline: WHO flags rising yellow fever transmission across Africa and the Americas
stories.summary: WHO's latest outbreak notice warns of sustained yellow fever transmission in Africa and a notable rise in the Americas, including spread into lower-risk zones, amid uneven vaccination coverage. It urged stronger surveillance and immunisation across the 40 high-risk countries.

cybersecurity.label: CyberSecurity
cybersecurity.ai_summary: Actively-exploited flaws dominate this cycle: Microsoft SharePoint and Oracle E-Business Suite bugs joined CISA's exploited list, and Cisco confirmed attacks on a Unified CM flaw. Adobe shipped seven maximum-severity (CVSS 10) ColdFusion fixes. AI tooling is squarely in the crosshairs -- attackers weaponised a Langflow RCE for ransomware, and researchers found holes in Cursor, AI coding agents and AI browsers. Patch SharePoint, Oracle EBS, Cisco, Adobe and Kemp LoadMaster now.

stories.headline: Microsoft SharePoint RCE added to CISA KEV after active exploitation
stories.summary: CISA added a Microsoft SharePoint Server remote-code-execution flaw (CVE-2026-45659, deserialization of untrusted data, CVSS 8.8) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after confirmed in-the-wild attacks. It affects SharePoint 2016, 2019 and Subscription Edition; admins should patch immediately.

stories.headline: Cisco confirms attackers exploiting Unified CM SSRF flaw
stories.summary: Cisco confirmed active exploitation of a server-side request forgery flaw (CVE-2026-20230, CVSS 8.6) in Unified Communications Manager that lets unauthenticated attackers write files and potentially escalate to root, though the vulnerable WebDialer service is off by default. Patching is advised.

stories.headline: Unpatched Argo CD repo-server flaw could let attackers take over Kubernetes clusters
stories.summary: Researchers disclosed an unpatched flaw in Argo CD's repo-server component that could let attackers compromise Kubernetes clusters. With no fix yet available, teams are urged to restrict exposure and monitor for abuse.

stories.headline: AI agent exploits Langflow RCE to automate database ransomware attacks
stories.summary: Attackers are weaponising a remote-code-execution flaw in the Langflow AI app-builder -- earlier abused to drop Monero miners -- now using an AI agent to automate ransomware against exposed databases. Exposed Langflow endpoints should be patched and taken offline.

stories.headline: FortiBleed credential-theft campaign linked to INC and Lynx ransomware
stories.summary: A credential-theft campaign dubbed 'FortiBleed', targeting Fortinet devices, has been tied to the INC and Lynx ransomware operations, researchers said. Stolen credentials are being used for initial access ahead of encryption.

stories.headline: New ChocoPoC RAT targets vulnerability researchers via fake PoC repos
stories.summary: A new RAT called ChocoPoC is spreading through trojanised proof-of-concept exploit repositories aimed at security researchers, echoing past targeting of the security community. Researchers should vet PoC code before running it.

stories.headline: Medtronic notifies customers hit by ShinyHunters data breach
stories.summary: Medical-device maker Medtronic began notifying customers affected by a breach tied to the ShinyHunters extortion group, part of a wider wave of data-theft attacks. The exposed data and scope are still being assessed.

stories.headline: 19-year-old Scattered Spider suspect extradited to face US hacking charges
stories.summary: A 19-year-old alleged member of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group was extradited to the United States to face hacking charges, following a related arrest in Finland. The group is tied to a string of high-profile social-engineering intrusions.

stories.headline: Adobe patches seven CVSS 10.0 flaws in ColdFusion and Campaign Classic
stories.summary: Adobe released fixes for seven maximum-severity (CVSS 10.0) vulnerabilities in ColdFusion and Campaign Classic that could allow remote code execution and system compromise. Given the perfect-score ratings, administrators should apply the updates urgently.

stories.headline: Oracle E-Business Suite flaw actively exploited; 900+ instances exposed
stories.summary: A critical Oracle E-Business Suite flaw (CVE-2026-46817, CVSS 9.8) in the Payments component is being exploited in the wild for full system compromise, with over 900 exposed instances observed. Oracle's patch should be applied immediately.

stories.headline: Critical Cursor flaws could let prompt injection escape sandbox and run commands
stories.summary: Researchers found flaws in the Cursor AI code editor that could let a prompt-injection attack escape its sandbox and execute commands on a developer's machine. It underscores growing risk in AI-assisted developer tooling; users should update.

stories.headline: Progress Kemp LoadMaster pre-auth RCE flaw faces active exploitation
stories.summary: A pre-authentication remote-code-execution flaw in Progress Kemp LoadMaster is drawing active exploitation attempts, researchers warned. Internet-facing load balancers should be patched and access restricted.

stories.headline: Citrix patches six NetScaler flaws allowing file read and denial-of-service
stories.summary: Citrix released fixes for six NetScaler ADC and Gateway vulnerabilities that could enable unauthorized file reads and denial-of-service. Given NetScaler's history as an attacker target, prompt patching is advised.

stories.headline: Azure CLI password spray hits 78 Microsoft accounts in 81M+ attempts
stories.summary: A large password-spraying campaign abusing the Azure CLI made more than 81 million login attempts and compromised at least 78 Microsoft 365 accounts, researchers said. Organisations should enforce MFA and monitor for CLI-based authentication abuse.

stories.headline: Microsoft warns poisoned MCP tool descriptions can make AI agents leak data
stories.summary: Microsoft warned that maliciously crafted Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool descriptions can manipulate AI agents into leaking data, a fresh supply-chain-style risk for agentic AI. It urged validating and pinning trusted MCP tool definitions.

stories.headline: AI-generated browser ransomware abuses Chromium API across platforms
stories.summary: Researchers detailed AI-generated ransomware that abuses a Chromium browser API to encrypt files across Windows, Linux, macOS and Android. The proof-of-concept highlights how generative AI is lowering the bar for cross-platform malware.

stories.headline: DHS confirms hackers breached HSIN information-sharing platform
stories.summary: The US Department of Homeland Security confirmed attackers breached its Homeland Security Information Network (HSIN), used to share sensitive information with partners. DHS said it is investigating the scope of the intrusion.

stories.headline: SimpleHelp flaw exploited to deploy TaskWeaver and Djinn Stealer
stories.summary: Attackers are exploiting a critical SimpleHelp authentication-bypass flaw (CVE-2026-48558, CVSS 10.0) to deploy TaskWeaver and the Djinn infostealer; CISA has added it to its KEV catalog. Remote-support server admins should patch and hunt for compromise.

stories.headline: GuardFall exposes open-source AI coding agents to shell-injection risks
stories.summary: Research dubbed 'GuardFall' found that several open-source AI coding agents are vulnerable to decades-old shell-injection techniques, letting crafted inputs run arbitrary commands. Maintainers were urged to sanitise agent-executed commands.

stories.headline: AirDrop and Quick Share flaws let nearby attackers trigger crashes and bypass checks
stories.summary: Newly disclosed flaws in Apple's AirDrop and Android's Quick Share could let nearby attackers crash devices and bypass security checks over wireless file-sharing. Users should update once fixes are available and disable sharing when unused.

stories.headline: 282 iOS AI apps found leaking API keys and exposing AI proxy access
stories.summary: A network-traffic study found 282 iOS AI apps leaking API keys and exposing open AI-proxy access, which could let attackers run up costs or abuse backend models. Developers were urged to move secrets server-side.

stories.headline: Apple patches 30+ iOS, macOS and Safari flaws, including AI-discovered WebKit bugs
stories.summary: Apple shipped fixes for more than 30 vulnerabilities across iOS, macOS and Safari, including WebKit bugs surfaced with AI-assisted analysis. Users should update promptly given past exploitation of WebKit flaws.

stories.headline: Mustang Panda abuses Zoho WorkDrive as C2 channel in Indian government attacks
stories.summary: The China-linked APT Mustang Panda is abusing Zoho WorkDrive as a covert command-and-control channel in attacks on Indian government targets, researchers said. The campaign blends legitimate cloud services to evade detection.
